sources.title: Beckoning Darkness
markers: | summary = It curses a creature to take {{DamageType|Necrotic}} damage if it enters or starts its turn in a {{SmCond|Lightly Obscured|Lightly}} or {{SmCond|Heavily Obscured}} area.

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves and an extra 1d4 Necrotic on weapon attacks. This rare version grants Beckoning Darkness.

fields.Umbral Attack: Weapon attacks deal 1d4 extra Necrotic. Gain +1 Strength saving throws.
fields.Beckoning Darkness: Bonus Action. Target a creature within roughly 13 ft. A DC 14 Charisma save resists the curse. For 2 turns, entering or starting its turn in a lightly or heavily obscured area inflicts 2d8 Necrotic.
fields.Base value: 290 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
